investigations.name: Stadtwerke Niesky GmbH
investigations.evidenceSummary: Current first-party page identifies one public SWN station at Zinzendorfplatz. Bundesnetzagentur-derived current registry closes that installation at 3 EVSE: 2 x CCS 150 kW (DE*SAE*E7020*01, *02) and 1 x Type 2 AC 22 kW (*03). Current m8mit checkout explicitly exposes anonymous/direct credit-card tariff 0.50 EUR/kWh gross on CCS *02 and AC *03.
investigations.exactGap: Checkout for second CCS EVSE DE*SAE*E7020*01 could not be retrieved independently. Do not infer same tariff merely because it is the twin CCS connector on the same installation. Need explicit checkout/backend payload for *01 or an authoritative station-level tariff rule binding all 3 EVSE.

investigations.name: Stadtwerke Parchim GmbH
investigations.evidenceSummary: Current m8mit guest checkout for DE*MSU*EPCH*WW10*01 exposes Gasttarif - PCH at 39.85 ct/kWh gross + 1.99 EUR Direct-Pay fee. First-party FAQ points users to the m8mit station overview and mentions multiple fast/public locations.
investigations.exactGap: Operator denominator is not closed: current public m8mit index is paginated/incomplete in the retrievable surface and first-party wording lists locations non-exhaustively ('u. a.'). Need exhaustive current operator EVSE inventory before promotion.

investigations.name: Stadtwerke Bernburg GmbH
investigations.evidenceSummary: First-party Stadtwerke Bernburg price sheet explicitly separates Direct-Pay from Basic/Premium card tariffs and states Direct-Pay AC gross price 70.39 ct/kWh plus 2.50 EUR start fee per session; billing is via m8mit/MSU. Current m8mit inventory exposes the operator's Bernburg AC estate.
investigations.exactGap: The explicit price sheet found is valid from 2024-01-01 and no current 2026 confirmation/version was found. Historical numeric tariff cannot be treated as current without revalidation. Need current first-party price sheet or current checkout sample matrix covering the active estate.

nextSafeAction: Continue to another small m8mit/MSU candidate with a closed first-party denominator and current checkout. For Niesky, promote immediately only if E7020*01 direct checkout/backend payload is recovered and matches the explicit 0.50 EUR/kWh anonymous tariff. No production merge.
